Record notes

Write, refine and evaluate prompts with complete source-grounded methods, optional local tooling and traceable handoff briefs.

Version 0.2.1 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Full canonical methods, references and framework builder; optional official Prompt Engineer skills require a separately installed verified Codex provider.

Requirements: Your task facts, draft prompts or test cases; Optional official Prompt Engineer: prompt-engineer@openai-curated-remote on verified Codex hosts; Optional recipient-owned Prompt Compass and Atlas bindings; Framework Builder requires Python >=3.10 and MCP dependencies; Optional Promptbanken app and separate Work Management or Master Security Toolkit.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream MIT scopes as listed in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add prompt-playbook-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from b4a5518f735098ce65058885c62778bee72688dd. SHA-256: 53ea7e930a7edea4425a363f09e47d6cb2e6e1b01317b5187940bc55c1d2af1a.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
